conventions.note: Endpoints are called by the mobile app; none is currently available to yago-ai-api. Tools and cards are proposals (implemented=false).

endpoints.notes: one POST per leisureForm; dynamic form
cancels by lodgingIdPms+restaurantId, not by booking id
favorite = notification eventType 'evento'; local reminder scheduled by app

gaps.description: No /me endpoint to derive guest context from token
AI uses snapshot and simulated bookings
No detail-by-id endpoints for bookings, requests, events
Unconfirmed server validation of lodgingIdPms and guest ids against token
Leisure age ranges hardcoded by category UUID in app
POST experience/sign may not exist in production
No idempotency on POST order / booking-restaurant / experience-booking
No SPA scheduling or boutique purchase
Quiz backend contract not documented in repo
numberOfGuests = whole lodging, not selected party
